messages:
maria: heads-up — noticed about 3k users still hitting legacy routing despite rollout completion.
jordan: where's the TTL coming from? replication job or console cache?
sam: looks like config-service marks applied on leader only; followers replay lag is seconds normally but this is hours.
lee: saw `flag_state_version` mismatch in traces. trace id: trace-9a7b1, sample logs attached.
maria: quick sql dump: `SELECT id, key, value, updated_at FROM feature_flags WHERE key='route_by_cost' AND updated_at < now() - interval '1 hour'` — lots of old rows.
config-bot: Automated alert: config-applier retry rate spike 2.3x at 11:02 UTC :eyes:
jordan: proposal: add per-flag staleness TTL + background reconciliation that force-pushes to sync-store with exponential backoff. console UX should show `last_synced` and `discrepancy`.
sam: agree but guardrails first — don't force-push if `dry-run` or an active cohort override exists. can we have a 'preview-only' reconcile mode?
lee: UX suggestion: add 'Sync' button in flag detail. clicking shows diff preview, e.g.:
```
+ cohort-A: enabled
- cohort-B: disabled
```
and a risk summary.
jordan: ops ask: expose per-tenant staleness metric + a staleness-alert webhook so customers/operators can monitor.
maria: API sketch:
`POST /api/v1/flags/:id/reconcile?mode=preview|apply`
returns `applied:[], conflicts:[], ops_token_required:bool`.
sam: watchouts: reconcile must respect `activation_window` and `canary_quota`. On conflicts -> create audit entry and put flag into `quarantine` with auto-rollback timer.
lee: canary plan: sample 1% tokens for 10m, check latency/error_rate/QPS. if stable, promote.
maria: :thumbsup: I'll draft an ADR and ping @eng-sre and @product for gating.
jordan: add migration plan for existing flags and a db index to avoid full table scans (we hit one during the dump).
maria: quick index: `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_flags_updated_at ON feature_flags(updated_at);` — will add to ADR.
config-bot: Deploy succeeded: config-reconcile-runner v0.7.2 -> canary (1 node).
sam: scheduling a short ops runbook for first-run; I'll own it.
lee: follow-up: add telemetry tag `reconcile-runner:initiator` (user|system) so we can filter false positives later.
maria: noted — will post ADR in #eng-docs when draft is ready.
